proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6391 dugdha gives Gujarati/Marathi dūdh and unaspirated regional dud/dūd milk. Independent visual inspection of Northern Dhule physical p. 109, printed p. 101, item 91 shows plain/dental d with dental subscript marks, not the retroflex reading stored in the source ledger. The link follows the printed milk word. Stored forms and durable IDs remain unchanged pending source correction; the exact intra-Indo-Aryan transmission is open. Stored survey form ḍuḍ is preserved.
